{{Quote|I knew my kid brother was on assignment with her. Might have been my assignment, but the Jedi Council of Seers saw Kol as the one for it.|[[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk]] telling Cade Skywalker about his mother, Morrigan Corde|<ref name="L24" />}}
The '''Council of Seers''' was a [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] in operation prior to the rule of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]] and his [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].

==Overview==
The Council of [[Jedi Seer|Seers]] was one of at least two [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Councils]] functioning during the era immediately preceding the [[Sith–Imperial War]], a conflict that would be fought between the [[Fel Empire|Imperial government]] of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="L24" />

The Council members perceived that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kol Skywalker]] was the one to be assigned on a mission that otherwise might have been assigned to [[Rawk|Nat Skywalker]]. While on the assignment, Skywalker met [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Morrigan Corde]] who he fell in love with, leading to their betrothal and the conception of a Force-sensitive son, [[Cade Skywalker]].<ref name="L24" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Council of Seers is briefly mentioned in the twenty-fourth [[Star Wars comic books|issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' series, [[Legacy (2006) 24|''Loyalties, Part 2'']].
